acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given my financial data including a flexi facility, when I calculate the Flexi Chunking Strategy, then it models regular lump sum deposits from the flexi facility to the highest-rate debt account, with the flexi being repaid from income over subsequent months.

Given my financial data with a flexi facility, when I calculate the Aggressive Flexi Strategy, then it models maximum deposits to the flexi facility with minimum withdrawals (only for required expenses), using daily interest savings to accelerate debt payoff.
Both strategies correctly model flexi daily interest compounding versus standard loan monthly interest compounding, capturing the interest arbitrage opportunity.
Given no flexi facility exists in the financial snapshot, when either flexi-based strategy is calculated, then it returns null or a "Not applicable - requires flexi facility" result (not an error).
Effort levels are assigned: Flexi Chunking = 'medium', Aggressive Flexi = 'high'.

Each strategy returns a StrategyProjection with all required fields: strategyId, strategyName, effortLevel, debtFreeMonth, debtFreeDate, totalInterestPaid, totalPrincipalPaid, monthsSaved, interestSaved, monthlyProjections[].
Both strategies implement the DebtStrategy interface with calculate() and allocatePayment() methods, following the Strategy Pattern (ADR-004).
All calculations use big.js for precision with cent-level accuracy (2 decimal places in ZAR).
Unit tests verify that both strategies perform better than baseline and traditional strategies when a flexi facility is available with favorable rate differential.

constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations MUST use big.js, not JavaScript native numbers (ADR-003)
Strategies MUST implement the DebtStrategy interface exactly (ADR-004)
Flexi strategies MUST set requiresFlexi: true
Flexi strategies MUST return null (not throw) when snapshot.flexiFacility is null
All Big values MUST be rounded to 2 decimal places for ZAR precision
Strategy files go in src/lib/calculations/strategies/ directory
Test files go in tests/lib/calculations/strategies/ directory
Must register new strategies in strategies/index.ts getAllStrategies()
Interest arbitrage: Flexi uses daily compounding (rate/365 x days), debts use monthly (rate/12)

tests.standards: Vitest is the testing framework (vitest ^4.0.14). Tests use describe/it/expect pattern. Test files are in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Tests should be organized by acceptance criteria using describe blocks (e.g., describe('AC-4.4.1: ...')). Use Big.js instances for assertions, comparing with toFixed(2) for monetary values. Current test count: 980+ passing tests. Build must pass with no type errors.
